document: docs/41-试点课堂Start持久迁移内核SDD.md
summary: AGENT-START-12/13 已在设计层闭合：plan_ready 在 Registry 前绑定最终 Agent 计划，逐次工具有 started/result 事件及受信 provenance；但 SDD 把 T-01 自我介绍写成‘叮叮老师’，与 docs/04、Golden 和 fallback 的‘叮当老师’矛盾。

findings.title: Teacher-name assertion contradicts the golden and fallback
findings.evidence: The SDD says the rendered opener must contain ‘叮叮老师’, whereas docs/04 OP-1, the SDD golden sentence, and its fallback all say ‘叮当老师’. An implementation following the assertion rejects its own required golden/fallback; one following the golden violates the assertion.
findings.required_change: Use the decided product name ‘叮当老师’ consistently in assertion, OP-1, fallback, and tests; cross-check docs/04, docs/41, and scripts seed/template text.
